title: Cloud Security: security meter charges
content:
Cloud Security handling of category meter charges is governed by these handling clauses.

## Measured Security services

The reference protected workload count is the protected-count plan reference, not a free workload allowance.

Primary workload-hours use primary unit rate.

Log ingestion bills monthly GB beyond included monthly ingestion GB at telemetry ingestion rate.

Included searchable storage covers included searchable retention days; archive bills GB-month after that retention segment at archive storage rate, and retrieval bills retrieved GB at archive retrieval rate.

Artifact scanning bills scanned GB at on-demand scan rate only for on-demand scan operations beyond included monthly on-demand scan operations in the same calendar month; scheduled scans are included and recorded separately.

Key operations are billed in units of thousand operations at key operation rate.

Premium managed rules bill actually enabled premium package-months at premium rule package fee.

Incident assistance bills customer-authorized delivered specialist-hours beyond included monthly specialist assistance hours at specialist assistance hourly rate.

A refunded or cancelled investigation without delivered time has no charge.

A separately held Managed Backup service does not provide security log retention, and Security archive does not count as a backup copy.

The service record records actual configured retention and completed included operations so a later service does not reuse an exhausted allowance.

For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under the tax basis.

An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval start time then original source event reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices.

These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

The unrounded ancillary subtotal is the measured quantity less its applied inclusion, floored at zero, multiplied by the selected ancillary rate.

## Basis Q&A

**Is a mandatory minimum fee a separate charge?**

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Undelivered investigation

Hypothetical case: an investigation is cancelled and no specialist time was delivered. It has no incident-assistance charge.
